title: Return Policy for Ridgeline Orders & Delivery Purchases: Eligibility, Channels and Refunds
content:
**1. Return window.** Items bought through Ridgeline Orders & Delivery may be returned within the days set for their item category in the program's return windows, counted from the fulfilled date as day 0; a category set to 0 is not returnable, and a return on the last day qualifies.

**2. Condition of eligibility.** The return must be made no later than the item category's return window after the order was fulfilled.

- *Clock start.* The business event is the fulfillment of the order, that is its delivery or pickup. The date used is the fulfilled date shown in the order record of the order the items were bought on; the customer's account of when the items arrived does not replace it, and the date is read before the return is credited.
- *Counting.* The fulfilled date is day 0. Adding the category's window in calendar days to the fulfilled date gives the last day of the window.
- *Comparison.* The date the return is made must be no later than that last day. A return made on the last day itself qualifies.
- *Category set to 0.* An item in a category whose window is 0 is not returnable, on any day.

| Date of the return | Meets the window |
|---|---|
| On or before the last day of the window | Yes |
| On the last day of the window | Yes |
| After the last day of the window | No |

*Boundary example (illustrative dates, for a category with a 30-day window).* An order fulfilled on 2026-04-01 has 2026-04-01 as day 0, and day 30 is 2026-05-01. A return made on 2026-05-01 qualifies; a return made on 2026-05-02 does not.

**3. Where items come back.** Returns are accepted at any store, by mail where the program allows returns by mail (the program's mail-return label charge is deducted), or by home pickup for truck and appliance deliveries (the program's home pickup return charge). Both charges are waived when the program waives return fees for defective, damaged or wrong items and the reason for the return is defective, damaged in delivery, or wrong item.

| Channel | Charge | Waived when |
|---|---|---|
| Any store | No return charge is set | Not applicable |
| By mail, where the program allows it | Mail-return label charge, deducted | The program waives return fees and the reason is defective, damaged in delivery or wrong item |
| Home pickup, for truck and appliance deliveries | Home pickup return charge | The same |

**4. Damage to a delivered appliance.** Damage to a delivered appliance is covered only when reported within the program's damage-reporting hours after delivery, or refused at the door where the program provides inspection with the crew at delivery.

**5. Delivery charge on a return.** The delivery charge is refunded with a return only for the return reasons the program lists for that refund.

**6. Refund and order status.** The refund goes to the tender of the order payment. Each return is credited against the order with its return receipt number, the item category, the reason (changed mind, defective, damaged in delivery, or wrong item) and how the items came back (store, mail or home pickup). When every item of the order has been returned, the order status becomes returned.
